title: Integral strict-local sections agree with geometric-fibre sections
statement: Let Λ be a commutative ring, f:X→Y integral [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], s:Spec Omega→Y a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point], and (g',f',f,s) Cartesian [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square]. Let F be a sheaf of Λ-modules on X_et [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Let A be the strict henselization at s, ρ:Spec A→Y its structural map [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit; def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-structural-map], Z=X×_Y Spec A with projection p:Z→X. There exists a module isomorphism e:Γ(Z,p^*F)≅Γ(X',g'^*F), evaluated on the identity etale object on X'. For every small-model affine pointed neighbourhood j=(V_j,v_j), r_j followed by e.hom is R_(V_j,v_j). Here r_j is the actual unit and limit-leg restriction qcqsStrictLocalSectionRestriction [lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-strict-local-module-comparison]; R is the unit for g' restricted along the lift with projections (f' followed by v_j,g') and the identity of X'. This theorem compares only sections on the two schemes and asserts no neighbourhood representative existence.

proof.text: Obtain the strict henselization local structure. Equip the geometric field with its residue-field algebra via descResidueField. The pointed-map theorem supplies the compatible ring map; construct t by Spec.map. Its pointed leg identity and the structural-map equation imply t followed by the structural map is s. The closed-fibre characterization then puts its image at the closed point.

Construct i by pullback.lift from g′ and f′ followed by t. Its two projection equations follow by pullback.lift_fst and pullback.lift_snd. Pullback pasting yields the closed geometric fibre square. Integrality survives base change, and the integral strictly-henselian fibre restriction theorem makes the global-section map along i invertible.

The definition strictLocalFibreRestriction composes this invertible map with the inverse-image composition and terminal-section isomorphisms. Take its asIso. The compatibility theorem gives exactly the required neighbourhood restriction formula.

theorem exists_integralStrictLocalFibreComparison
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ]
    {X' X Y : Scheme.{u}} {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ Spec (.of Ω)} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    {s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Y} (sq : IsPullback g' f' f s) [IsIntegralHom f]
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) :
    ∃ e : (Sheaf.Γ (pullback f (strictHenselizationStructuralMap s)).smallEtaleTopology
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj
        ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)
          (pullback.fst f (strictHenselizationStructuralMap s))).obj F) ≅
      ((g')^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ].obj F).obj.obj
        (op (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X'))),
      ∀ j : SmallModel.{u} (strictHenselizationNeighbourhoods s),
        qcqsStrictLocalSectionRestriction Λ f s F j ≫ e.hom =
          geometricFibreSectionRestriction Λ sq.toCommSq F
            ((AffineEtale.Spec Y).obj
              ((equivSmallModel.{u} (strictHenselizationNeighbourhoods s)).inverse.obj j).1)
            ((equivSmallModel.{u} (strictHenselizationNeighbourhoods s)).inverse.obj j).2
